title: Sum of Distances
summary: Given an integer array nums, create an array arr of the same length where arr[i] represents the sum of absolute differences |i - j| for all j where nums[j] equals nums[i] and j is not equal to i.
statement: Given an integer array nums, create an array arr of the same length where arr[i] represents the sum of absolute differences |i - j| for all j where nums[j] equals nums[i] and j is not equal to i. If no such j exists, set arr[i] to 0. Return the array arr.
constraints: For each index i, consider every other index j with nums[j] equal to nums[i].
Set answer[i] to the sum of |i-j| across those indices.
Return the full answer array; unique values receive zero.
hints: Group indices by their array value.
Within one sorted index group, maintain the sum of processed indices and the total group sum.
Compute left cost as index*left_count-left_sum and right cost symmetrically.
Every equal-value index lies on exactly one side or is the current zero-distance index, so the two formulas sum precisely all required distances.
editorial: Every equal-value index lies on exactly one side or is the current zero-distance index, so the two formulas sum precisely all required distances.

tests.explanation: The three ones occur at indices zero, two, and three, producing distances five, three, and four.
Every value is unique, so every distance sum is zero.
